description: Weekly US crude oil supply data from EIA. Metrics: 'production' (US field production), 'imports' (weekly oil imports), 'stocks' (commercial crude stocks), 'refinery_inputs' (gross refinery inputs). Filter by PADD region. Default: national production.

end.description: Inclusive upper-bound period (ISO date or YYYY-MM).

start.description: Inclusive lower-bound period (ISO date or YYYY-MM depending on series cadence).

name: eia_oil_supply
